sources.snippet: Ziqi Huang Ziqi Huang is a fourth-year Ph.D. student at MMLab@NTU, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, advised by Prof. Ziwei Liu. She received her Bachelor's degree from NTU. She has internships and collaborations with Meta Superintelligence Labs, Netflix, ByteDance, A*STAR, and Shanghai AI Lab.
